categories.label: Round score
categories.help: Sum of your face-up cards at the end of the round, after any doubling penalty.

notes: Lowest total wins. The game ends after the round in which a player reaches 100, recorded as target_score. Ties are shared. Category list recalled from the publisher rulebook and not yet re-checked against the printed copy (see source.checked_against_rulebook).
